FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 403
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Ron Bolton
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/16/2024
House Bill 403 as introduced could increase the obligations of counties by an undetermined
amount to inspect and issue permits for certain all-terrain vehicle (ATV) parks pursuant to the
provisions of this bill. This increase in obligations would be offset, in whole or in part, by the
permit fee set by the county commission, in an amount not to exceed a maximum of $50.
This bill could also increase receipts to county road and bridge funds from fines by $5,000 for
each day a park operates in violation of the provisions of this bill.
Further, this bill would allow counties to contract with the State Forester to provide inspectors
to investigate compliance with this bill.
